name: Shimukappu (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Shimukappu village emblem in green and orange: a green ring open at the top with an orange stylised letter Y and ring.
history: Municipal flag of Shimukappu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 11 October 1963.

features.role: Shimukappu village emblem — a green ring open at the top with an orange stylised letter Y and ring
